person.persName: شهوان بن عجل بن رميح السيد النموي

death.note: He died in the year 892 AH. The funeral prayer was performed for him in Mecca, where he was then buried.

relation.note: The ruler of Mecca contemporary with his death in 892 AH was Muḥammad b. Barakāt (AIND-D07156, r. 859–903 AH).
Identified with Fāṭima bt. al-Sayyid Barakāt b. Ḥasan b. ʿAjlān (AIND-D13403), sister of Muḥammad b. Barakāt; "aiḍan" (also) implies his mother too belonged to the ruling house.

person.note: シャフワーン・ビン・アジル・ビン・ルマイフ。アッ＝サイイド、アン＝ヌマウィー。マッカの支配者の娘婿（娘の一人と結婚）。母もまたバラカートの娘ファーティマである。ヒジュラ暦892年に死去。マッカで葬儀礼拝が行われたのち、埋葬された。

Shahwān b. ʿAjl b. Rumayḥ, al-Sayyid al-Numawī. He was the son-in-law of the ruler of Mecca, having married one of his daughters. His mother too was Fāṭima, the daughter of Barakāt. He died in the year 892 AH, and the funeral prayer was performed for him in Mecca, where he was then buried.
